FIELDS.NAME: AV Solutions Inc.
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Inspection Coordinator, AV Solutions Inc., (555) 123-4567, johndoe@avsolutions.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: AV Solutions Inc. specializes in the retail sales of new audio and visual equipment, including televisions, speakers, amplifiers, and microphones, with a commitment to quality by avoiding the sale of used goods. In addition to direct sales, we provide services for event-related A/V equipment such as projectors and lighting, ensuring all items are well-maintained and tested before each use. Our operations are conducted from a dedicated retail showroom equipped with appropriate security measures to mitigate theft risks. We also offer professional installation and servicing of A/V equipment carried out by certified technicians, backed by documented experience and expertise. To ensure accuracy in operations, we have established comprehensive inventory management systems to track stock and minimize losses. AV Solutions Inc. operates with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and operational integrity, complying with industry standards and regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: AV Rental Solutions LLC - Specializing in audio and visual equipment services for corporate events and parties.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2023, a theft incident occurred during store hours resulting in the loss of new audio equipment valued at $1,000. The case is currently under investigation by local authorities. The equipment was not recovered. Additionally, on August 5, 2023, a customer returned a projector due to malfunctions, resulting in $250 in repairs. Both incidents are reported and managed under our insurance policy.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL 3-Hour Fire Rated Safe with Combination Lock, for securing valuable audio and visual equipment.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel present during store hours to monitor customer activity and prevent theft.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – AV Solutions Inc. does not engage in operations involving the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous materials. The business is focused on retail sales and rental of audio and visual equipment, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety regulations.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our compliance team to ensure all necessary insurance requirements are met.

The business operates with a commitment to integrity and compliance with all relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – AV Solutions Inc. has not experienced any policy or coverage declines, cancellations, or non-renewals in the past three years. The business has maintained continuous coverage through its previous carrier, AudioSure Insurance Co.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – AV Solutions Inc. does not lease employees to or from other employers. The company employs its staff directly to ensure quality service and oversight.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – AV Solutions Inc. carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect against employee-related risks.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – AV Solutions Inc. also operates AV Rental Solutions LLC, which specializes in audio and visual equipment rental services for corporate events and parties.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – AV Solutions Inc. does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The only policy currently is the one mentioned in the application.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – AV Solutions Inc. is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; the focus is solely on retail sales and rental of audio and visual equipment.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: Yes – AV Solutions Inc. rents A/V equipment such as projectors and lighting for events, ensuring that all items are well-maintained and tested before each rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – AV Solutions Inc. has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a solid financial standing without any recorded distress.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – AV Solutions Inc. does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus primarily on the retail and rental of audio and visual equipment. We ensure compliance with all safety regulations and do not engage in activities involving hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – AV Solutions Inc. does not have any known catastrophe exposure, as our operations primarily involve retail and rental of audio and visual equipment without involvement in high-risk activities or environments.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – AV Solutions Inc. has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance with employment regulations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – AV Solutions Inc. has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all applicable safety regulations.
